title.romaji: Toumei Otoko to Ningen Onna: Sonouchi Fuufu ni Naru Futari
title.english: The Invisible Man and His Soon-to-Be Wife
title.native: 透明男と人間女～そのうち夫婦になるふたり～

synonyms: รักใส ใจละมุน กับคุณที่มองไม่เห็น
description:
Akira Tounome is an invisible gentleman who runs a detective agency, and Shizuka Yakou is a mild-mannered human female who works there. Shizuka can always find Akira even when he turns completely invisible. A quiet love begins to blossom between them as the invisible man and blind girl grow closer to each other…

(Source: Crunchyroll)

node.description: She is a blind, gentle human woman who works as an office worker at the "Tonome Detective Agency." She has a keen sense of hearing, smell, and touch. She is a romance novice and is flustered by Tounome's approach.

A detective at the "Tonome Detective Agency," he is an invisible, gentlemanly non-human. He can make not only his own appearance but also the clothes he is wearing completely invisible. He is attracted to Yakou.

A beastwoman investigator at the Tonome Detective Agency, primarily handling security and heavy lifting. She has a big-sister personality and is highly proactive, though she can be a bit careless at times. She nervously watches over the distance between Tonome and Yako while rooting for them.
Tonome Detective Agency investigator, a human male primarily responsible for information gathering. Appears blunt but is actually meticulous. Tsundere. Keeps romance separate from work.

name.native: カルマ＝ダーク＝アマネセル

node.description: A Dark Elf who runs the tea and light specialty shop “Elf Garden” with his wife, Light. He possesses the power of “curses,” and when anxious, he sometimes unknowingly curses those around him. A playful mood-maker, though he occasionally loses control...?

name.native: ライト＝オーワイト＝フェストゥス

node.description: A White Elf who runs the tea and karma specialty shop “Elf Garden” with her husband Karma. Possesses the power of “blessing” and can bestow divine protection. Though gentle and kind-hearted, she also possesses the strength to rein in Karma's reckless behavior.

A lawyer who frequently visits “Tonome Detective Agency” for investigation requests, he is a bright and sociable human male. He has been Daichi's partner since high school. Though he disliked mountains, an incident during a high school field trip turned him into a camping enthusiast.
Light's father, a White Elf who runs a major pharmaceutical company. He worries about Light, who eloped, and does not accept Karma, a Dark Elf, as Light's husband.
[Shizuka's](https://anilist.co/character/350618/) younger brother. He is a second year in high school.
